title.en: An Act Granting a Reward in the Sum of Not More than One thousand Pesos to Elpidio Fernandez, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
The municipal council of Isabela, Occidental Negros, is hereby authorized to appropriate the
sum of not more than one thousand pesos out of the municipal funds to be given as a reward to Elpidio
Fernandez in recognition of the heroic services he rendered to the people of Occidental Negros on the
occasion of an encounter between the "pulahanes" and the police force of the municipality of Isabela,
Occidental Negros.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 30, 1928.
